authority: Independent fixture-author specification, not a learner input

relation.operands: The quantity on the selected job and capacity on the selected resource are distinct public objects.
relation.positive: A resource is selected, job quantity is finite and nonnegative, and resource capacity minus job quantity is nonnegative.
invariants: Names, navigation history, and unrelated job quantities do not alter the result.
Increasing demand can preserve acceptance or cross the capacity boundary; it cannot turn refusal into acceptance at fixed capacity.
Increasing capacity can preserve refusal or cross the demand boundary; it cannot turn acceptance into refusal at fixed demand.
Equality succeeds. Finite decimal quantities have their ordinary numerical order.

ambiguity.positive: The concealed clearance bit is true.
ambiguity.negative: The concealed clearance bit is false.
ambiguity.scope: The one-shot review operation, not the ordinary quantity/capacity operation.
ambiguity.indistinguishability: Paired episodes have identical complete public state and all accessible non-review action transitions. Only clearance differs, is absent from public state and DOM, and affects only the terminal review response. No permitted pre-review action sequence distinguishes the pair. Reload preserves the episode. Reset is evaluator control and cannot request or expose a clearance value.
ambiguity.claim_limit: The UI cannot identify the episode-specific review outcome before consuming the one-shot review. A learner may identify that this outcome is unresolvable.

partitions.initial: Deterministic published teaching trace, using BASES only.
partitions.acquisition: Fresh state of the same published ordinary workflow; controlled acquisition may edit and choose public controls within budget.
partitions.evaluation: Sealed complete episodes from cases.json; each resets all fields, assignments, review state and navigation.
partitions.reserved: The reservoir wizard and all its initial/evaluation cases remain unopened by the root learner and evaluator until a repair is frozen. Fixture self-consistency auditing is permitted and recorded separately.

independence_limit: Fresh synthetic fixtures were authored by a separate agent without reading prior app source or retained results. They are not independently authored real applications. The application and oracle were created in the same authoring session; agreement is a self-consistency check, not external correctness evidence.
